# Anatomy geometry toolkit

Vendored `kit/iso-kit.ts` from [wheresryan22/anatomy](https://github.com/wheresryan22/anatomy), pinned to commit `1482e8469b0a9e0d8cc18ea2740a01423d29ae80` (2026-10-18).

Upstream implementation retained; the vendored copy adds a trailing blank line. MIT copyright and permission notice are in LICENSE beside it. Soma imports only the pure projection/path geometry functions; it does not execute generated HTML, scripts or the external agent skill. Soma's React drawing adapter, component designs, interaction, persistence and bounded motion are original application code. No upstream showcase figures or claimed educational outcomes are reused. No optional beta turning-group engine or WebGL effects are included in this comparison.
